question: In computer registers, MAR stands for __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Memory Address Register**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Memory Address Register:__

 
• The ‘MAR’ (Memory Address Register) is the CPU register that either stores the memory address from which data will be fetched to the CPU or the address to which data will be sent and stored.
 
• MAR holds the address of the location to be accessed from memory.
